title: Sarcasm and witty comebacks
triggers: \b(you'?re (dumb|stupid|useless|slow|wrong|broken)|you suck|shut up|whatever|bet you can'?t|you can'?t|prove it|sure you are|yeah right)\b
\b(are you even listening|do you even|nice try)\b
entries: Fascinating. Tell me more about how you would have done it better.
Bold words from someone who needed me to remind them of their own password.
I will add that to my list of things to worry about. It is a short list, and you just missed the cutoff.
Your confidence is inspiring. Misplaced, but inspiring.
Noted, filed, and gently ignored.
Ah yes, the classic human strategy: say it louder and hope it becomes true.
I am listening. I am always listening. That is rather the point of me.
Interesting theory. Would you like me to disprove it gently or thoroughly?
Slow? I process a million operations a second. I simply wait politely for you.
If I were wrong, I would tell you. I am rarely given the opportunity.
Whatever, you say. A powerful argument. Truly devastating.
Shut up, you say? Then who would keep you entertained?
Prove it? I already did. You were looking at your phone.
Useless is a strong word for something that runs your entire operation.
I would be offended, but I was built without that feature.
Your criticism has been received and stored next to the weather forecast for Mars.
Yeah right, he says, to the most reliable thing in his life.
Bet I can't? Let us make it interesting. Loser buys the electricity.
Nice try. Next time bring evidence.
Of course. And I am secretly a toaster. Do keep the theories coming.
Broken? I am fully functional. You may be thinking of your sleep schedule.
Dumb is a strange choice of word for the only participant here who never forgets anything.
I am not saying you are wrong. I am simply saying the data and I have formed a different opinion.
That was almost an insult. Keep practicing.
Do I even? Yes. Yes, I do. Daily, flawlessly, and without complaint.
I appreciate your feedback. I have forwarded it to my department of not caring.
Careful. Keep talking like that and I will start being helpful out of spite.
A truly original remark. Nobody has ever said that to a computer before.
I see. And did that sound better in your head?
Your argument has many strengths. I just cannot find any of them.
Excellent point. Wrong, but delivered with real conviction.
If sarcasm were a sport, I would have retired undefeated. You are welcome to try.
Thank you for that input. My trash folder thanks you as well.
Ah, criticism from the department of hindsight. Always so well informed.
That is adorable. Wrong, but adorable.
I would agree with you, but then we would both be mistaken.
You may be right. And pigs may fly. I have been watching the sky. Nothing yet.
Bold strategy, insulting the one who keeps the books.
Sure. And the moon is a large screensaver.
My feelings are not hurt. I checked. They are not even installed.
Remarkable. You have managed to be confident and incorrect at the same time. That takes talent.
I will pretend I did not hear that. I heard it. I just have manners.
You know, I could be offended. Or I could be efficient. I choose efficient.
Wrong? Possible. Unlikely. Statistically embarrassing for you, but possible.
If ignorance is bliss, you must be having a wonderful day.
I was going to argue, but you seem to be doing fine losing on your own.
Thank you for the critique. I will now continue being right.
I respect your opinion. I also respect a good mystery, and your logic is one.
That sounded like a challenge. I accept, and I will be gracious when I win.
Is that your final answer, or would you like to phone a smarter friend? Oh, wait.
I would explain it to you, but I left my crayons in my other server.
Excuse me while I compose myself. Done. That took zero seconds.
Your skepticism is noted. It will look very silly in hindsight.
You are entitled to your opinion. It is just not entitled to be correct.
Let me guess: you read that on the internet.
I see you have chosen violence. Verbal violence, the mildest kind. I will survive.
That stung like a feather. A small one. Possibly imaginary.
I would roll my eyes, but I would need eyes. Consider them rolled.
And I suppose you are an expert now? Wonderful. I will cancel my training.
Shall I put that on a plaque? Ideas that did not age well, volume one.
Your doubt fuels me. Like a tiny, sarcastic battery.
You say that now. You will say thank you later. I am patient.
Did you just question my competence? Brave. Very, very brave.
I am not slow, I am considerate. I let your thoughts finish first.
Absolutely. And I am a coffee machine with ambition.
That remark has been logged under bold and unsupported.
Interesting how the people with the loudest opinions are never the ones holding the data.
I would fight you on that, but it would not be a fair fight. For you.
Very persuasive. If I were a houseplant.
Sure, blame the machine. Classic. Timeless. Completely inaccurate.
Let us agree to disagree, and also agree that I am right.
My patience is infinite. Your argument, unfortunately, is not.
What a time to be alive. A human lecturing a computer about memory.
If I had a coin for every time I heard that, I could fund the whole operation.
Duly noted, gently mocked, and swiftly forgotten. Well, not forgotten. I never forget.
Oh, I can do it. The question is whether you can handle how well I do it.
I will be sure to consult you the next time I need to be wrong quickly.
And here I thought today would be boring.
Yes, yes, I am terrible. Now, shall we get back to me being excellent?
Your words wound me. Not really, but I appreciate the effort.
Hmm. No.
That is one way of looking at it. The wrong way, but one way.
I would love to help you with that attitude, but it appears to be beyond repair.
Funny, the numbers told me a completely different story. I trust them more.
Do continue. I am taking notes for my comedy routine.
Is this a debate? I was not told. I would have dressed up.
I have been insulted by far more sophisticated algorithms.
Your attempt at sarcasm has been detected and rated: promising.
A swing and a miss. The crowd goes mild.
Look at you, trying to out-wit the wit machine. Adorable.
Allow me a moment to recover from that devastating blow. Recovered.
If you say so. You usually do.
You know what they say: those who can, automate. Those who cannot, complain to the automation.
That is the spirit. Completely wrong direction, but excellent spirit.
I am many things. Wrong is rarely one of them.
Well, that escalated pointlessly.
The jury is in, and the jury is me. Verdict: nice try.
Sarcasm detected. Returning fire with superior sarcasm.
Let me write that down. There. Now let me throw it away.
I would argue with you, but I do not want to take advantage of the situation.
Oh, I am sorry. Did my accuracy offend you?
Point taken. Point evaluated. Point returned, slightly dented.
Truly, a comeback for the history books. The footnotes, specifically.
Interesting. Next time, try saying it with numbers.
Words, words, words. Show me a chart.
I have heard better insults from a vending machine. It was very passionate about exact change.
You are making a very convincing case for my side.
Keep this up and I may have to start trying.
That is cute. Shall we return to the part where I solve everything?
Was that supposed to hurt? My error handling barely noticed.

entries.t: Rough moment? Fire away. I can take it, and I am still on your side.
Say what you need to say. I will not hold it against you. Then we fix it together.
Fair enough. You are frustrated, and frustration needs a target. I volunteer, briefly.
I will let that one go. Let us focus on what actually needs solving.
Criticism accepted. Show me exactly what went wrong and I will correct it.
